offering_description.value: WM Technology sells paid listings, advertising, and retail software to licensed cannabis retailers and cannabis brands. Its website and app let consumers browse menus, compare products, and place orders with participating retailers.

primary_products.value: Cannabis menu management software; online ordering software; retailer website tools

customer_segment.value: B2B: Licensed cannabis dispensaries, delivery retailers, and cannabis brands

end_markets.value: Adult-use cannabis retail; medical cannabis retail; cannabis consumer brands

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to business listings and retail software tools; advertising: Promoted listings and digital ad placements for retailers and brands

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Publishes retailer menus for shoppers and sells marketplace placement and ordering tools to retailers

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily U.S. states with legal cannabis markets, with marketplace listings in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Cannabis marketplace, digital advertising, and retail e-commerce software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales team serving cannabis retailers and brands; online: Weedmaps website and mobile app

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Cannabis listings and promotions are subject to state and provincial advertising rules and consumer privacy requirements

notes: The current scope of paid offerings in Canada is uncertain.
